drills.title: Advice, collocations and plans
drills.instructions: Choose the best answer. Check the explanation after you finish.

questions.prompt: You should ____ a short break before starting the next task.
questions.explanation: The collocation is take a break.

questions.prompt: Can you ____ a list of what we need for the trip?
questions.explanation: The collocation is make a list.

questions.prompt: The deadline is close. We should ____ the teacher for help.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb after should.

questions.prompt: If I ____ my tasks now, I’ll have more time after dinner.
questions.explanation: The if clause in this first conditional uses the present simple.

questions.prompt: If the weather gets worse, the guide ____ us back to the center.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb for this likely consequence.

questions.prompt: I made a plan before leaving the room, so I could relax. What does so introduce?
options: A reason that came before the plan
A result of making the plan
An event that interrupted the plan
questions.answer: A result of making the plan
questions.explanation: The plan allowed the speaker to relax.

drills.title: Experiences and imagined choices
drills.instructions: Choose the best answer. Check the explanation after you finish.

questions.prompt: Have you ever ____ a wildlife center?

questions.explanation: Last Saturday is a finished past time.

questions.prompt: She has been training ____ two months.
questions.explanation: For introduces a period of time.

questions.prompt: If I had more time, I ____ at the park every week.
questions.explanation: The imagined situation uses if + past, then would + base verb.

questions.prompt: We were following the path when it ____ to rain.
questions.explanation: The past simple event interrupts the action in progress.

questions.prompt: Lena borrowed boots from the center. They kept her feet dry. What does ‘they’ refer to?
questions.explanation: The sentence says the borrowed boots kept her feet dry.

interview: What helps you relax after a busy day?
